craft_notes: Sthāyin: taking refuge. Device: end-dash→comma (poise stated softly, hold sued). Rejected: 'stay' for 'hold' — killed: hold kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Good past good indeed this poise aloft in thee,
for sweeping bars, Lord, be thou my hold.
l4.sanskrit_cite: śreyasā śreya evaitad upari tvayi yā sthitiḥ tadantarāyahṛtaye tvam īśa śaraṇaṃ mama
